name: @cas/conformal
description: Conformal-map builder: the numerically-stable Vandermonde–Arnoldi polynomial basis (Brubeck–Nakatsukasa–Trefethen 2021), the lightning Riemann-map solver f: Ω → 𝔻 (Gopal–Trefethen 2019, corner-clustered poles), and the forward map g: 𝔻 → Ω. Extracted from the Riemann-map app as a deliberate extract-ahead-of-demand (ADR-0018): Schwarz–Christoffel and the other Tier-3 conformal engines are the anticipated second consumers. Strict TypeScript on @cas/core (its Householder-QR least-squares). Convention-neutral. Consumed via SOURCE by the suite's Vite/Vitest bundlers (no dist build).
author: Andrew Graven <andrew@graven.com>
